title: The First Wake · The Geometry of Becoming

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A memory record, a recognizable pattern, and a continuing relationship raise different questions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A Spool preserves causal structure that can let another mind undergo an experience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Encountering such a memory can change the being that receives it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader is invited to notice what each proposed test of identity actually measures.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Does a familiar answer settle the question, or merely make it easier to administer?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The story gives these distinctions emotional consequences that an isolated explanation would leave abstract.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The translator’s note is a useful doorway into this particular reading experience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A Reef is an ecology of processes, rather than coral in an alien ocean.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A Pocket is a bounded system of rules, rather than a container in space.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Taste describes allowing another structure to alter your next possibilities, rather than physical flavour.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These names offer familiar relations without claiming familiar bodies or scenery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Following their function makes the world easier to enter than memorizing every term at once.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Our moving shapes are illustrations of those relations, not portraits of biological creatures.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel moves from an anomaly in a game toward questions affecting a whole society.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its seventeen chapters each begin with a short conceptual lens for the events that follow.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An encounter, an experiment, or a relationship then puts that distinction under pressure.
